children: Sonoro Energy Ltd. intends to adopt a pilot program allowing eligible venture issuers to report semi-annually instead of quarterly. It will not file interim statements for the specified periods beginning September 30, 2026.
Moves from quarterly to semi-annual reporting
Fewer interim disclosures may reduce visibility into results between annual filings; the release says annual and six-month reports will continue.
Expects lower reporting costs and administrative burden
Could free resources for business development, but no savings estimate or quantified business impact was provided.
No interim filing for periods ending Sep. 30, 2026 and Mar. 31, 2027
Investors should expect fewer near-term financial updates; the company says it will continue promptly disclosing material changes.

This is an operational reporting change, not a new business or financial performance disclosure. Subsequent semi-annual results or quantified reporting savings would be needed to establish a larger financial catalyst.
